title: The product triple ((0,1) × M, θ∘π, e₀ ∧ ξ∘π) is a rectifiable triple
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k], with Φ, π, Φ′, y₀, e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 and ι(v) = Φ(0, v) as in the parent, and assume (MP): for every A ⊆ ℝ^P that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A). Let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple univ m M θ ξ in ℝ^P (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1, as in the frozen contract) with θ ≥ 1 on M. Then there is ξ′ : ℝ^{P+1} → Λ_{m+1}(ℝ^{P+1}) (NVector (Eucl (P+1)) (m+1)) such that IsRectifiableTriple univ (m+1) M̃ θ̃ ξ′ holds for M̃ := {y : π(y) ∈ M ∧ y₀ ∈ (0, 1)} and θ̃ := θ ∘ π, and such that ξ′(Φ(s, x))(α) = ξ(x)(β) for all s ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^P, α ∈ Λ^{m+1}(ℝ^{P+1}) and β ∈ Λ^m(ℝ^P) with β(v) = α(e₀, ιv_1, …, ιv_m) for every v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m (i.e. ξ′ = e₀ ∧ ξ∘π, Simon 3.2(2)).
